name: forge
description: Forge — Work orders, journey progress, artifacts, ForgeScore, dev activity, and project context for AI-assisted development workflows.

skills.name: artifact-collaboration
skills.description: Display, edit, and collaborate on Forge journey artifacts — formatted downloads, markdown updates, impact analysis, and inline section comments. Use when the user wants to view formatted artifacts, update PRD/BRD/intent, comment on artifact sections, or analyze downstream impact

skills.name: dev-activity
skills.description: Sync and validate developer activity in Forge — pull commits and PRs from linked repos, verify data consistency, and replay missed events. Use when the user wants to sync development activity, validate commit history, or recover from missed events.

skills.name: forge-score
skills.description: Query ForgeScore codebase health metrics for a project — composite score, dimension breakdown, findings, and history. Use when the user asks about code health, ForgeScore, maturity level, or score trends over time.

skills.name: journey
skills.description: Manage Forge journey progress — stage approvals, generation, chat, and blockers. Use when the user asks about journey progress, stage approvals, unlocking stages, generating artifacts, journey chat, or staleness/blockers.

skills.name: project-context
skills.description: Set up and query Forge project context — select projects, list linked repos, manage artifacts, and configure repositories. Use when the user asks about project setup, linked repositories, artifacts, UX references, journey state, project search, or wants to switch between projects

skills.name: work-orders
skills.description: Manage Forge work orders — list, pick, update, transition, and complete development tasks. Use when the user asks about their current task, next work item, wants to update progress, create PRs, prepare commits, post comments, ask clarifications, or manage workflow stages.

subagents.name: forge
subagents.description: Forge Agent — manages work orders, journey progress, artifacts, ForgeScore, dev activity, and project context for AI-assisted development. Invoke for task management, approvals, artifact collaboration, commit workflows, and project setup.

rules.name: forge-conventions
rules.description: Forge workflow conventions — ensures work order alignment, journey discipline, artifact safety, and proper project context usage

commands.name: forge-connect
commands.description: Install and connect the Forge MCP server (one-click install), verify auth, configure session, and select your project.

commands.name: forge-status
commands.description: Validate Forge MCP connection and print a readiness status report — includes install steps if disconnected.

commands.name: forge-context
commands.description: Load Forge project context — journey progress, linked repos, and key journey artifacts (intent, PRD, PRD-Spec, architecture, RTM).

commands.name: forge-artifacts
commands.description: Fetch, search, download, comment on, or update Forge journey artifacts — PRD, PRD-Spec, BRD, architecture, RTM, and more.

commands.name: forge-orders
commands.description: Browse Forge work orders — stats, filtered list, task details, comments, and clarifications.

commands.name: forge-sync
commands.description: Sync commits and PRs from linked repos to Forge — run after push or before completing a work order.

commands.name: forge-journey
commands.description: Load Forge journey progress — stage status, approvals, blockers, staleness — and offer approve, generate, or chat actions.

commands.name: forge-score
commands.description: Load ForgeScore codebase health — composite score, dimensions, findings, and optional history trend.

commands.name: work
commands.description: Show your current work order or pick the next one — quickly see what to work on.

commands.name: start-work
commands.description: Full end-to-end workflow — select project, pick work order, implement, test, commit, push, create PR, and update status.
